# ractermx_domain (Resource)

Manages a RacterMX domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage a RacterMX domain with email forwarding enabled.
resource "ractermx_domain" "example" {
  name              = "example.com"
  catch_all_enabled = true
  catch_all_forward_to = "admin@example.com"
  max_aliases       = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The domain name (e.g., example.com). Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `catch_all_enabled` (Boolean) Whether catch-all forwarding is enabled.
- `catch_all_forward_to` (String) The email address to forward catch-all mail to.
- `dns_mode` (String) The DNS mode for this domain. One of: scan_only, mx_forwarding, dns_hosted.
- `is_forwarding` (Boolean) Whether email forwarding is enabled for this domain.
- `is_hosted` (Boolean) Whether DNS hosting is enabled for this domain.
- `is_monitored` (Boolean) Whether monitoring is enabled for this domain.
- `max_aliases` (Number) Maximum number of aliases allowed (1-1000, default 100).
- `organization_id` (Number) The organization ID to assign this domain to.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the domain was created.
- `dkim_verified` (Boolean) Whether DKIM records are verified.
- `dmarc_verified` (Boolean) Whether DMARC records are verified.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the domain.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the domain is active.
- `is_verified` (Boolean) Whether the domain has been verified.
- `last_verified_at` (String) The timestamp of the last verification check.
- `mx_verified` (Boolean) Whether MX records are verified.
- `spf_verified` (Boolean) Whether SPF records are verified.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the domain was last updated.
- `verification_token` (String) The verification token for this domain.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a domain using its numeric ID.
terraform import ractermx_domain.example 123
```
